comment: Good views if you go the right way, lots of roots gravel and rock on the harder trails, and steep downhills as well as long hikes uphill
Very easy but nice!
Nice route using the Bruce Trail a lot of the time.  A couple nice lookouts as you get into the later half off the loop.  Some challenging climbs and declines at different parts.
Really nice trail on a hot and sunny day. Lots of shade and cool breezes on top of the escarpment.
Wonderful section of the Bruce Trail. A bit muddy after yesterday's downpours. Sadly, the lookouts looked out over fog today, but I bet the views are wonderful.

Ski area that couples as a great hiking and trail bike loop series of trails in warmer climate. 
I’d recommend going counter-clockwise on this loop as it’s great to leave the n ie views from the Escarpment at the end of the 7km loop.
Nice challenging hike up the ski hill at the start of the trail. Friendly people on the trail. Thank you to all the users for keeping the trail so clean!

25ish cm snow depth in places and barely any on roads ofc. Wintry mix terrain. But the views were awesome. Feels much closer to clouds due to cloudy weather + elevation. 
Small problem, you have to start at campbellville road in contrast to what the app suggests, i.e., from twiss road. The part where all trails wants to start the trail has absolutely no parking area. It is a small narrow section of the road and it was difficult to even stop there let alone park. Hence, started in the parking lot at campbellville. 
Decided to turn back because my  “waterproof” shoes were soaking wet . 
Also, there is a ski area where it gets confusing. Even the trail itself can be confusing if covered in snow like it was for me. 
Good news : a coyote has literally walked the whole trail so forget your gps just let that coyote guide you.
Hilltop views were really awesome though. Would've liked to get a chair and just sit there in the snow for hours on end.

Great trail. Took the dogs out on a 2hr hike and they loved it. A little dangerous at the top of the hill where there is a steep drop off. Keep a extra eye on your dog if he is off leash. Paths were great, not muddy at all. Moderate hike i would say and overall excellent.
Very good trail, starts with fall view and got couple of great points to view
Beautiful..
Good epic view of cliffs at the end.
Hiked on the Fox loop during the Fall, and I must say it was one of the best hikes I've ever done. Great trailer markers along the way.
Rocky, moderate to hard!
Beautiful trail with lots of view points
It’s a beautiful trail with a few lookout points. I really enjoyed for 12km hike
Be sure to have AllTrails! The signage for the trails is poor.
Great day for a hike. Trail is beautiful.
Nice trail, except for the middle part that led behind the ski lift operation.  Far from attractive, and always with the highway din in your head
Awesome greenery and easy to moderate challenge.

The trail head was hard to find because of the construction. You need to take the tunnel by the Learning Centre. I made my own route which is easy to do because of the trails visible in the map. I had done some of it on another hike so I decided to stay in the forest. The students running the camps are very polite.
Beautiful trail. Well maintained, solid elevation, and unbelievable views.

Nice changes in elevation, great views at times, and the trail is well maintained. It as still pretty buggy on a 30° July day but not unmanageable. I didn't see a single person on trail. A lot of trail options aside from the main course, could easily spend a whole day here.
have to pay $27 to park in the conservation area but has different trails at different difficulties with nice lookouts
There were a Lot of  mountain bikers, keep in mind  it’s shared path

Stunning views and lush forests. So many fun side trails to check out too! Arguably my fav of the Halton Conservation Areas. 

Costs about 13 dollars a person to enter the park.
Fox spotted on the fox loop
Parts of trail are closed for walking from May to August for the extreme biking thingy they got going on. Starts everyday at 4
Beginning and end you’re on the ski hill, ascent and descent. Once you’re on the trail, it’s interesting escarpment trail.
Not my favourite section of the Bruce Trail. Lovely walk with some hills, but the drone of the 401 was in the background. Birthday hike.
Rainy day. We cut the trip a bit sorry, but it was fun and pretty!
Some bits are closed off due to ski season
Great walk in a cool weather.
The app trail did not completely follow the trail and at times it was a bit confusing- we did the fox loop.
Well maintained, wonderful trail

Beautiful lookouts along the escarpment! Once you're up there, the trail itself is mainly earth and tree roots. The elevation change going up to the top of the escarpment is moderately difficult, but the rest of the route is fairly easy. I deviated from the AllTrails path near the end to do more of the Bruce Trail.

Lovely loop trail! Definitely needed Alltrail open to stay on the right path, but it wasn’t too complicated. Fall leaves are still beautiful right now! Though many are down. You can take a shortcut up/down the chair lift line on the east side to avoid walking the access road if you like.
Good trip,  All Trails app is a must for this hiking trail.
Great trail. Some decent climbs. Beautiful scenery. Go early as it gets crowded.
Wonderful trail of moderate intensity. Perhaps it may help with some proper signage. As without AllTrails app one will definitely get lost. Surely recommend
Very busy with people taking the ski lift up - in particular the look out area - falls colours spectacular
Great fall colours today from the elevated parts of the trail. I
Awesome nature trail
Nice moderate trail. Beautiful day. The only thing that would make the trails better would be better markings. We got lost a few times and had to back track. Even with this app.
Beautiful. Decent  amount of shade. Hot in the sun, part of the hike was buggy

Great trail for being so close to the cities. Lots of biking paths that you can take to lengthen your hike, or shorten. Not too many people now and only a few bikes this Friday afternoon. Surprised to find mosquitoes still buzzing around, probably due to hot weather. Nice views from the ridge.
Always bring toilet paper on your hike.
Sometimes got lost on bike trails. Make sure to check where you’re going as there are also lots of different paths
It’s great to have lots of paths to choose even though the All trails guided route is very helpful. However, it’s time of the year to have too many mosquitoes.

Trail was good. Some road walking, some rock and tree root walking.  Some spots are very narrow and I wouldn’t want to meet a biker on that path. We ran into two groups of bikers. Otherwise we didn’t see any other person. Views are nice. Bugs were pretty bad.
Not too crowded, nice scenery.

Great trail for Biking. Hiking and lookout points. 

Steep climb and descends - so need to have proper shoes, rocky trail 

Overall amazing experience
Good walking shoes a must, take water with you. Moderate terrain.

It was hot today so we sweated buckets. Lots of bikers, some bugs but not mosquitoes, we enjoyed being covered from the sun. Discovered water park for kids- great place for the summer days for parents. Need to pay for access. Lots of parking

Mostly bike routes. Can hike them as well but be cautious of bikers, all the ones we came across were friendly and gave us a warning that they were passing :) I’d prefer Hilton falls hike even though it’s more crowded with people but nice not having to worry about stepping to the side for bikers
Nice views, mostly a swift walk
Lots of mountain bikes
Nice trail, well maintained and lots of routes to pick from within the big loop at Kelso. Not many people on weekday evening.
Great condition, no mud today before the rain
Trails are a bit muddy after the rains.
hard hike, great views. please note that it does cost money to get into this trail.
Great trail! A lot of different elevation levels and well maintained
A lot of cyclists to watch out for.
Well maintained and relaxing. Perfect hike.

Decent trails with a good amount of challenge if you walk up the ski hills.

Be sure to bring your bug spray as the mosquitoes are vicious.
Lots of bikes but beautiful trail
Trail in perfec conditions.
Watch out for mosquitoes

Well marked trails, and lots of them. Nice lookouts, and generally quiet and peaceful on the trails. Lots of mosquito's and quite a bit of mud out there. But overall, a great time. I would say the difficulty for this is closer to easy.
Very well maintained! Amazing hike with a nice lookout spot.
Nice trail not too buggy.  Great views.
Perfect trail with views. Rocky terrain but great. Great conservation area, well maintained, clean washrooms. Lot of stuff to do in this area
Easy
Super easy trail.

Did Fox Loop in about 1hr 30 mins. Trail was well maintained, steady uphill stretches (never too steep) and easy to navigate. Some good lookouts from the top. Parked by the West Ticket Gate and easy start to the trail by going over the chair lift tunnel from the gate building. 
First weekend of June was not too buggy but would prepare with bug spray as it is mostly in forested shade.
Great trail - not too buggy - shared with cyclists so stay alert for everyone’s safety
Well maintained and beautiful. The views are picturesque.
I went hiking in mid-May, and the trail conditions were great. Beautiful lookouts! Reservation+fee is required.

Kind of fun walking around a ski hill in the spring! The chairlifts were even operating for families who wanted a ride up the hill. Tons of options for trails, most connecting to and from the Bruce Trail. Surprisingly not too busy for a weekend, although probably because I was there earlier morning. Plenty of parking and washrooms. Would have liked to have visited the beach, but no dogs allowed.
Beautiful trail, I must say- not clearly marked though!
Nice easy escarpment trail
If looking for quick Lookout, take a left after getting down the chairlift. If looking for 4km trail as well as the lookout, go straight. Good luck.
Great hike! Mix of all different terrains and dog friendly as well
fabulous day with the family !
Was a good trail!
L The app should be in metric otherwise no used to me￼no

Great hike. Not too crowded.  About $10 per person entry and have to register ahead.  Start out to the right that way you start with a nice forest walk meandering uphill.  The other way is just winding up the ski hill to start.
Lots of bikers this holiday day.
Follow this trail around the outskirts of Kelso. You’ll pass by the lime stone kilns, have an easy ascent up the escarpment and catch all the lookout views￼

I was told there’s no access from Glen Eden in the winter by the girl in visitor centre, but there is, just very hard to find. Deep snow in most side trails but the main trail is fine. Thank other winter hikers! Good exercise and outdoor experience in the winter.
Pretty good hike. If you start from the tunnel and go left there are lots of hills to climb and then it's a pretty slow decent as you loop around
Thanksgiving Monday, not too busy. Friendly people and best view found so far
Happy trails, watching for those bikers.
Just a warning that this section of the trail is shared with a lot of cyclists on Mountain bikes. The majority are very courteous, but we nearly got nailed a few times.
Familiarizing myself with the main perimeter trails- popular playground for mountainbiking
Good except for a new trail rider it was hard to maneuver around fast opposing traffic.
Great area, lots of paths to choose from and no mud.
Completed the Iroquois Section of the Bruce Trail - series of utility hikes to fill in missing gaps - this was the final piece!  Some road walking but generally pleasant.
Too crowded, but some nice vistas.
Good signage for the most part. Maps need a “you are here”.
Great trail but you can hear the vehicle traffic at almost any time of the hike. I'll try again during a snowy day which might help impede the sound of the 401.
Spectacular!! During Covid be sure to make an online reservation. Part of the Bruce Trail. So many trails in there and incredible views!
Bit of elevation gain off the start, not too cool just yet. Watch out for bikers on the trail.
Great
Nice lookouts.
Better for bikes
We got a bit lost on the way down. The markings weren’t there at snakes and ladders but we had this app and that was perfect.
We pretty much explored many of the trails and side trails. Happy Father's Day!
Still closed for COVID-19 as of May 12, 2020

I like Kelso for running as it's not too rocky so you can get some good pace work on the packed trails. It's just challenging enough from a rocks and roots perspective to keep you alert but not so bad you cant run (like some parts of the Bruce trail in the area).

As a hike I wouldn't suggest this route - it 's really a MTB trail without too many vistas (2 I think) and lot's of gravel road.

Awesome choice of loop trails, great lookout points. Started on the fire trail and ended up with the escarpment view! Awesome day, only a couple of hikers and a few bikers. All respect for bikers going on the x-treem trail! lol.

once you get up the hill into the forest its a hikers heaven, so many trails to take. All trails had markers with the names. Just be careful of bikers otherwise it has something for all level of hikers.
